question: Can the exact qualified QuickSRNetSmall 2x ONNX artifact be loaded and executed in a native Android app while preserving backend requests, timing boundaries, output identity, failures, and device context as append-only receipts?

target.socExpectation: Snapdragon 8 Gen 2; must be confirmed from device metadata before use as observed evidence

included: deterministic 64x64 RGB gradient input and 128x128 output
CPU, XNNPACK, NNAPI, and QNN HTP probe as separate requested backends
session creation time and 5 warmup plus 30 measured Session.run attempts
P50 and P95 latency, success denominator, output shape, finite/range checks, and output SHA-256
device, thermal, battery-temperature, and process-memory snapshot when Android exposes them
excluded: camera, decoder, encoder, MediaCodec, display, or continuous video
image-quality, temporal-stability, PSNR, SSIM, or user-study claims
INT8 quantization or fixed-shape accelerator compilation
JNI or a C++ Android integration claim
public redistribution of the model or APK

timingBoundary.sessionCreation: asset bytes already read; measures OrtSession construction only
timingBoundary.runLatency: measures OrtSession.run call only with an existing direct FloatBuffer-backed tensor
excludedFromRunLatency: decode, colorspace conversion, render, and encode

predictions.statement: The local project should compile and package with the exact locked model when the Android SDK, JDK, cached Gradle, and Maven dependency are available.
CPU should execute the 64x64 to 128x128 probe on a connected compatible Android device.
XNNPACK and NNAPI availability and performance are unknown until measured on the actual device and firmware.
QNN HTP is expected not to initialize from the stock onnxruntime-android AAR; a failure is an expected, preserved probe result rather than a hidden fallback success.
No valid full-frame or real-time video conclusion can be made from this probe.

hostBuildGate: model bytes and SHA-256 are verified before packaging
each host build attempt has a unique evidence directory
deviceGate: device identity is captured without serial number or raw fingerprint
each requested backend creates a unique receipt whether it succeeds or fails
30 of 30 measured attempts succeed for a PASS receipt
all output values are finite and within the declared tolerance
provider assignment remains explicitly unverified unless a trace is added later
acceptance.humanGate: pending; machine build or device execution cannot advance human review

stopRules: Do not silently use a different model when the locked artifact is absent or mismatched.
Do not report a requested backend as used when provider configuration failed.
Do not convert a QNN probe failure into CPU success.
Do not delete or overwrite a failed build or device receipt after a successful retry.
Do not extrapolate the 64x64 probe to video resolution or frame rate.
